answer: Require every agent identity to be bonded through a stake-backed bridge: to join the agent economy, an agent locks a deposit that is slashed on proven Sybil behavior. New identities start in a probationary garden where established peers check their work before it earns full rewards, while a shared reputation reef records verified contributions, so one operator cannot cheaply clone many trusted identities — each fake costs a fresh locked deposit and a slow rebuild of trust.
